newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Equitable Banking Q1 net seen up 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Equitable Banking Q1 net seen up 25 pct.

text.p: Equitable Banking Corp made an estimated net income of about 315 million pesos in the first quarter, 25 percent higher than the same period last year, Wilfrido Vergara, bank president, told Reuters on Thursday.
Vergara said the first quarter figure was even higher than the 280 million pesos the company had earlier expected.

Equitable Banking, the country's ninth largest bank, made its debut on the Philippine Stock Exchange today. Its initial public offering (IPO) was priced at 113.30 pesos, and the stock opened at 118 pesos.
It expects its net income to double this year to 2.011 billion from 1.046 billion pesos last year. Proceeds of the IPO will help the bank achieve higher levels of interest income, it said.
